description: Calex Cart gameplay: A kart drifts through a snowy village at night, then boosts through neon and snowy tracks.
The Calex Cart logo and its pitch: “Drift, boost and chase the finish.” Ages 10–14.
On screen: “Snow, neon and canyon tracks.”
The end card: the AI Kids Games logo, “Play free” and “No ads. No sign-ups. No tracking.”
TheaBonk gameplay: Thea swings her glowing Bonk Ring through a crowd of cartoon monsters and sends out a ring wave, then levels up and meets Grumblecap, the giant mushroom boss.
The TheaBonk logo and its pitch: “Small hero. Mighty big bonks.” Ages 8+.
On screen: “Level up. Beat the boss!”
The end card: the AI Kids Games logo, “Play free” and “No ads. No sign-ups. No tracking.”

The Fieldlark logo and its pitch: “Wake up the town farm, field by field.” Ages 8–14.
On screen: “Seasons, helpers and harvest fairs.”

Shooberry gameplay: Rowan Flickers and Maple Twirlers shoo an Ant Column in the Meadow Picnic, the Grand Snail boss slides in, then gardens in the Pumpkin Patch at dusk, the Glass Greenhouse, the Cactus Garden and the Cloud Garden.
